title: Northern Watch
description: A northern task group investigates a developing contact picture across the GIUK Gap.

consequences.title: Allied ISR restricted
consequences.description: Partner nations flag your electronic and counterspace strikes. Reconnaissance tasking across the GIUK Gap is rationed while diplomats protest.

consequences.title: Rules of engagement tightened
consequences.description: Blinding satellites and disabling networks in one campaign draws NATO council scrutiny. Future hard targets require higher command approval.
